author: Russell Brand
description:
The Karmelo Anthony case becomes a mirror for something much bigger, because almost everyone approaching it seems to arrive with a story already written. As grief, race, justice, and anger collide, the deeper question is why so many people have lost faith that institutions can deliver fairness without turning every tragedy into another front in a wider cultural conflict.
